# Where the proxy resolves otherwise than dbt, one line each:
# CASE<TAB>SUBJECT<TAB>LOOKUP<TAB>ANSWERS<TAB>REASON, as the corpus prints it.
# See tests/proxy/conformance.rs.

ambiguous-ref	model.r.c ref('z')	graph	proxy {"model.pa.z", "model.pb.z"}, dbt {}	dbt fails on two packages defining it (dbt1005); the proxy names every candidate, as the owner decided
ambiguous-ref	model.r.c ref('z')	navigation	proxy {"model.pa.z", "model.pb.z"}, dbt {}	dbt fails on two packages defining it (dbt1005); the proxy names every candidate, as the owner decided
ambiguous-source	model.r.c source('s', 't')	graph	proxy {"source.pa.s.t", "source.pb.s.t"}, dbt {}	dbt fails on two packages declaring it (dbt1005); the proxy names every candidate, as the owner decided
ambiguous-source	model.r.c source('s', 't')	navigation	proxy {"source.pa.s.t", "source.pb.s.t"}, dbt {}	dbt fails on two packages declaring it (dbt1005); navigation gives both
disabled-package-model	model.pa.pa_m ref('x')	graph	proxy {"model.pa.x"}, dbt {"model.r.x"}	the scan reads no `+enabled: false`: the disabled model of the caller's package wins
disabled-package-model	node:model.pa.x	scan	only the proxy has it	the scan reads no `+enabled: false` from the root's dbt_project.yml
dispatch	macro.pa.fn adapter.dispatch('fn', 'pa')	graph	proxy {"macro.pa.default__fn", "macro.pa.duckdb__fn", "macro.pa.postgres__fn"}, dbt {"macro.pa.duckdb__fn"}	the graph names every implementation, dbt the adapter's only
dispatch	model.r.c2 adapter.dispatch('fn', 'pa')	graph	proxy {"macro.pa.default__fn", "macro.pa.duckdb__fn", "macro.pa.postgres__fn"}, dbt {}	dbt lists nothing for a dispatch called from a node; the graph names every implementation, dbt the adapter's only
dispatch-ref	macro.pa.fn adapter.dispatch('fn', 'pa')	graph	proxy {"macro.pa.default__fn", "macro.pa.duckdb__fn"}, dbt {"macro.pa.duckdb__fn"}	the graph names every implementation, dbt the adapter's only
dispatch-search-order	macro.pa.fn adapter.dispatch('fn', 'pa')	graph	proxy {"macro.pa.default__fn"}, dbt {"macro.r.default__fn"}	the graph follows no `dispatch:` search order (design.md, known limitations)
function	model.r.c -> function.r.double_it	scan	no call that the scan reads	the scan reads no function() call
function	node:function.r.double_it	scan	only dbt has it	the scan reads no functions
macro-in-package-macro	model.r.c via macro.pa.outer inner()	graph	proxy {"macro.pa.inner"}, dbt {"macro.r.inner"}	a macro call inside a macro resolves in the macro's package, then the root, as the owner decided; dbt's in the rendering node's (design.md)
macro-in-package-macro	model.r.c via macro.pa.outer inner()	navigation	proxy {"macro.pa.inner"}, dbt {"macro.r.inner"}	a macro call inside a macro resolves in the macro's package, then the root, as the owner decided; dbt's in the rendering node's (design.md)
macro-ref	model.r.c via macro.pa.get_x ref('x')	graph	proxy {"model.pa.x"}, dbt {"model.r.x"}	a ref in a macro resolves in the macro's package, dbt's in the calling node's (design.md)
macro-ref	model.r.c via macro.pa.get_x ref('x')	navigation	proxy {"model.pa.x"}, dbt {"model.r.x"}	a ref in a macro resolves in the macro's package, dbt's in the calling node's (design.md)
macro-unknown	node:model.r.c	scan	only the proxy has it	dbt drops a node whose macro is unknown (dbt1501); the scan keeps it
python-model	node:model.r.py_m	scan	only dbt has it	the scan reads no Python model
ref-var	model.r.c -> model.r.x	scan	no call that the scan reads	the scan reads no ref of a variable; the server's listing gives it
source-overrides	model.r.c source('stripe', 'charge')	graph	proxy {"source.stripe_source.stripe.charge"}, dbt {"source.r.stripe.charge"}	dbt 2 ignores `overrides` (dbt1060); the scan places the source in the package, as dbt-core
source-overrides	model.r.c source('stripe', 'charge')	navigation	proxy {"source.stripe_source.stripe.charge"}, dbt {"source.r.stripe.charge"}	dbt 2 ignores `overrides` (dbt1060); the scan places the source in the package, as dbt-core
source-overrides	node:source.r.stripe.charge	scan	only dbt has it	dbt 2 ignores `overrides` (dbt1060) and declares the root's own source; the scan drops it, as dbt-core
versions	model.pa.pc ref('m')	graph	proxy {}, dbt {"model.pa.m.v3"}	the scan knows no versions: a ref of one answers nothing
